about: Where each color in utils/colors.py comes from. A string is a name in rnv-brand (TABLE.key, or one of its own constants, in engine/brand.py); an object is a value this application owns, with the reason. Edit this file, then run: python tools/sync_colors.py

GRAY_44.why: gray(4) on the register's ink grid, which the register states as a rule and does not name. The pressed plate and the scrollbar handle (RNV-COLLAPSE-505050).

GRAY_EE.why: gray(14) on the ink grid. Static light surfaces, a list header and a scroll ground, that share hover-light's hex without being a hover.

GRAY_CC.why: gray(12) on the ink grid. The light-mode border.

GRAY_88.why: gray(8) on the ink grid. Muted text on dark; a scrollbar handle's hover on light.

GRAY_55.why: gray(5) on the ink grid. Disabled text and a checkbox edge on dark.

SELECTION_OVERLAY_COLOR.why: The blue overlay drawn during gradient and contrast selection, painted where no theme palette reaches.

GRAY_66.why: gray(6) on the ink grid. Muted text in light mode.

SEARCH_HIGHLIGHT_COLOR.why: The bright green border on slots that match a search.

SVG_EXPORT_BG.why: Data, not chrome: the background of an exported SVG palette file. White by meaning, so it does not follow the brand's white.

SVG_EXPORT_STROKE.why: Data, not chrome: the swatch stroke in an exported SVG palette file.

DATA_DEFAULT_COLOR.why: Data, not chrome: the value a color record starts with.

SESSION_FALLBACK_COLOR.why: Data: the gray a restored session or a reset setting falls back to.

SESSION_FALLBACK_COLOR_IMAGE.why: Data: the image-mode fallback for a reset setting.

CLIPBOARD_PREVIEW_COLOR.why: Data, not chrome: the example the settings dialog previews the hex and rgb() clipboard formats with, text shown to the person (#56 A).

TRANSPARENT_RGBA.why: Fully transparent: ghost pixmaps and cleared palettes.

DEFAULT_SLOT_COLOR.why: The color a new slot starts with in dark and light mode.
